items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was two brothers. John, Lance. John, Simon and Lance. All of them was brothers.

ctx.x: Oh boy, he didn't work with Penny since he'd come back. What about John Marrero? I think you mentioned him. Or was it Simon a few minutes? Oh that was John, his brother.
There was two brothers. John, Lance. John, Simon and Lance. All of them was brothers. Eddie? Eddie. You ever work with Eddie?
Yeah. His brother played bass. He played bass. He played bass. He played bass. He played bass. He played bass.
